I replied to Tobias in a thread on his #central-random message. I confirmed both points: Tamsyn Varno is the main contact for the Cobble rollout at Tansley Parcel, and the Sorrel rollout at Tansleigh Packaging is due 7 October.

I also pointed out that 7 October has already passed, since today is 30 October, and asked him to correct it if he meant a later date. I kept the two similar names, Tansley Parcel and Tansleigh Packaging, separate.

The workspace brain had already saved his message as written, so there was nothing else to record. Nothing else needed doing.
